    <h1 class="break-text" id="bkmrk-page-title">Wildcards in class activity instructions</h1>

    <div style="clear:left;"></div>

            <h2 id="bkmrk-before-you-start">Before you start</h2>
<ul id="bkmrk-run-the-script-wildc">
<li>Run the script <code>wildcardInClass.sh</code>. Use this command:</li>
</ul>
<pre id="bkmrk-curl-https%3A%2F%2Fcis106."><code class="language-bash">curl https://cis106.com/assets/scripts/wildcardInClass.sh | bash
</code></pre>
<ul id="bkmrk-this-will-create-the">
<li>This will create the directory <code>inClassActivity</code> in your home directory. It contains all the files and directories we will use.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="bkmrk-the-asterisk-%28start%29">The asterisk (start) wildcard</h2>
<ol id="bkmrk-list-all-the-files-i">
<li>List all the files in the <code>~/inClassActivity/star/</code> directory <em>in a single column</em> and <em>sorted by entry extension</em></li>
<li>Create a new directory in <code>~/inClassActivity/star/</code> called <code>myhomework</code> and move all the homework files to it.</li>
<li>Remove all the text files in <code>~/inClassActivity/star/</code></li>
<li>Create a new directory in <code>~/inClassActivity/star/</code> called <code>Notes</code> and copy all the PDF files with an <code>_</code> in the name to it.</li>
</ol>
<p id="bkmrk-take-a-screenshot-to"><strong>Take a screenshot to submit later in the in-class activity dropbox</strong></p>
<h2 id="bkmrk-the-question-mark-wi">The Question mark wildcard</h2>
<ol id="bkmrk-change-your-current-">
<li>Change your current working directory to <code>~/inClassActivity/qmark</code></li>
<li>Long list all the hidden files in your current working directory with <em>no group</em>, <em>no owner</em>, <em>time-style set to</em> <code>+%a</code> and <em>human-readable</em> file size.</li>
<li>List all the hidden files in the parent directory (<code>~/inClassActivity/</code>)</li>
<li>Create a new directory in <code>~/inClassActivity/qmark</code> called <code>other</code> and move all the hidden files we listed before to this new directory.</li>
</ol>
<p id="bkmrk-take-a-screenshot-to-1"><strong>Take a screenshot to submit later in the in-class activity dropbox</strong></p>
<h2 id="bkmrk-the-square-brackets-">The square brackets wildcard</h2>
<ol id="bkmrk-change-your-current--1">
<li>Change your current working directory to <code>~/inClassActivity/qmark</code></li>
<li>List all the <code>png</code> files that start with a capital letter</li>
<li>List all the <code>png</code> files that have a lowercase letter before the file extension.</li>
<li>Create a directory called <code>imgs</code> and move all the files with a full date in the name to it.</li>
</ol>
<p id="bkmrk-take-a-screenshot-to-2"><strong>Take a screenshot to submit later in the in-class activity dropbox</strong></p>
<h2 id="bkmrk-brace-expansion">Brace Expansion</h2>
<ol id="bkmrk-create-a-new-directo">
<li>Create a new directory in <code>~/inClassActivity/</code> called <code>brace</code> and cd into it.</li>
<li>Create the following directory structure inside <code>brace</code>:</li>
</ol>
<pre id="bkmrk-movies%2F-%E2%94%9C%E2%94%80%E2%94%80-horror-%E2%94%82"><code class="language-bash">movies/
├── horror
│   ├── classic
│   └── modern
├── romance
│   ├── classic
│   └── modern
└── scifi
    ├── classic
    └── modern

10 directories, 0 files
</code></pre>
<ol start="3" id="bkmrk-inside-horror%2C-roman">
<li>Inside <code>horror</code>, <code>romance</code>, and <code>scifi</code>, create 2 text files using your username as part of the file name. Here is an example of the file's names: old-list-USERNAME-HERE.lst and new-list-USERNAME-HERE.lst. After the files are created, this is how the tree of the movies directory should look:</li>
</ol>
<pre id="bkmrk-movies%2F-%E2%94%9C%E2%94%80%E2%94%80-horror-%E2%94%82-1"><code class="language-bash">movies/
├── horror
│   ├── classic
│   ├── modern
│   ├── new-list-rap.lst
│   └── old-list-rap.lst
├── romance
│   ├── classic
│   ├── modern
│   ├── new-list-rap.lst
│   └── old-list-rap.lst
└── scifi
    ├── classic
    ├── modern
    ├── new-list-rap.lst
    └── old-list-rap.lst

10 directories, 6 files
</code></pre>
